title: SG-5.6 · Admin round endpoints are provably mounted behind the admin token
summary: Unit tests prove admin round endpoints are mounted and answer with real handler statuses when called with the admin token
description: Context: server.New registers admin round routes from adminRoundRoutes under /api/v1/admin behind admin.Middleware. TestNew_AdminRoundsAreMounted only asserts status != 404, which is weak. Desired behavior: unit tests assert the exact status each mounted round endpoint returns with the admin token. Expected result: a missing mount or a broken handler mapping fails a test. Why: SG-5.6 requires proof that the endpoints are mounted when called with the admin token.
acceptance_criteria: Given a server with admin token tok and an on-disk round, when GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-0000001?world=the-boys-room is sent with Bearer tok, then the response is 200 with the round JSON
Given the same server, when GET /api/v1/admin/rounds/ROUND-9999999?world=the-boys-room is sent with Bearer tok, then the response is 404 from the handler
Given the same server, when POST /api/v1/admin/rounds is sent with Bearer tok and an invalid JSON body, then the response is 400
technical_constraints: Go tests with httptest and a temp dir only
No real Git, network or live ports
